segments.text: Increasing Physical Dimension

To enhance the physical dimension , a person needs to focus on his body and appearance using materialistic means— fitness, grooming, dressing well, and maintaining a healthy lifestyle . This improves his looks, personality, and presence in the physical world.
Increasing Astral Dimension

To elevate the astral dimension , a person must work on his subtle energy . This can be achieved through Surya Namaskar, Pranic Healing, Yoga, Tapasya, Mantra Chanting, and consuming specific sattvic foods that nourish the astral body.
The Power of Repetition and Principles

Following a set of principles consistently can also help increase one’s dimension —even without Bhakti . When a principle is followed with discipline and repetition , it becomes energized and starts assisting a person in his growth.
Example to Understand This

Imagine someone who is extremely punctual —he follows a strict schedule and value time deeply. Over the years, his punctuality gets energized and starts working in his favor, helping him rise in both physical and astral dimensions .

However, this growth has a limit . Without deeper spiritual efforts , the dimension can only increase to a certain extent . For true and unlimited growth , one must go beyond discipline and focus on higher spiritual practices .
The Power of Energized Energy in Dimension Growth
When a person uses an energized force as a base to increase his dimension, he can only rise as high as the dimension of that energy.
Understanding This Concept

Through Drishti, we can see that Mahadev has the highest dimension, which indicates that he was once human before reaching this supreme state. Similarly, Lord Ganpati and other deities also have dimensions, meaning they, too, were once human and have continuously elevated their dimensions over time.
One of the greatest examples is Shri Hanumanji Maharaj—a deity who possesses a dimension, proving that he was also once human and is still constantly upgrading his dimension.
Unlimited Growth Through Hanumanji’s Energy

In Ashaeiynn, our Gurutattva is Shri Hanumanji Maharaj, whose energy serves as a powerful base for aspirants. By aligning with his energy, one can continuously upgrade his dimension without any limitations. Unlike other energies that have a ceiling, this path offers endless growth and evolution!
The Guru-Disciple Connection in Dimension Growth
When a person chooses a Guru to help him increase his dimension, his growth is directly linked to the dimension of his Guru. A disciple can never surpass his Guru’s dimension.
How This Works
If the Guru’s dimension keeps rising, the disciple’s dimension also increases steadily.
But if something negative happens and the Guru’s dimension starts falling, the disciple’s dimension will also drop, as his level will always be below their Guru’s.
If the Guru is human, there is another limitation—once he leave his physical body, he can no longer upgrade his dimension.
At this point, the disciple’s growth also stops. And as we know, if a dimension is not upgraded continuously, it starts decreasing.
Example to Understand This

Imagine a student who is learning from a teacher. As long as the teacher keeps learning and growing, the student also improves. But if the teacher stops learning or faces setbacks, the student’s progress slows down. And if the teacher is no longer there, the student’s growth eventually stagnates and declines.
The Key Takeaway

To ensure continuous dimension growth, one must follow a Guru whose dimension is always rising, even beyond the physical plane. Otherwise, the disciple’s progress will be limited, and over time, their dimension will start decreasing.
